attchmntText: Bonlon Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Bonlon Industries Limited filed a statement of deviation or variation regarding the utilization of proceeds from its preferential issue of warrants for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company reported no deviation or variation in the use of funds from the objects stated in the notice of postal ballot dated April 07, 2025. The total amount raised was Rs. 3978.15 Lakh from the allotment of 1,20,55,000 convertible warrants on October 09, 2025. The statement was reviewed by the Audit Committee and taken on record by the Board at their meeting held on November 07, 2026. The company confirmed that no fresh allotment or conversion of warrants into equity shares occurred during the current quarter.

attchmntText: Un-audited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026
voiceSummary: Bonlon Industries Limited approved its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 during a Board meeting held on 14th November 2026. The Board also approved the Auditor's Limited Review Report on these results. Total assets stood at 18,445.10 lakhs as of 30th September 2026, compared to 14,680.45 lakhs as of 31st March 2026. Total equity was 10,176.40 lakhs. Net cash generated by operating activities was negative 188.43 lakhs for the half year ended 30th September 2026. Net cash used in investing activities was negative 1,697.59 lakhs. Net cash used in financing activities was positive 1,879.53 lakhs. The trading window remains closed until 48 hours after the disclosure of the outcome of the Right Issue committee Meeting scheduled for 18th November 2026. The meeting commenced at 10:00 PM and concluded at 11:00 PM.

attchmntText: Bonlon Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Bonlon Industries Limited board approved standalone unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Total assets stood at 18,445.10 lakhs as of September 30, 2026, compared to 14,680.45 lakhs on March 31, 2026. Total equity was 10,176.40 lakhs. Net cash used in operating activities was 188.43 lakhs for the half year ended September 30, 2026. Net cash used in investing activities was 1,697.59 lakhs. Net cash generated from financing activities was 1,879.53 lakhs. Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the period were 48.91 lakhs. The trading window remains closed until 48 hours after the disclosure of the outcome of the Right Issue committee meeting scheduled for November 18, 2026. The board meeting concluded at 11:00 PM on November 14, 2026.

attchmntText: Bonlon Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: Bonlon Industries Limited has scheduled a Rights Issue Committee meeting for Wednesday, November 18, 2026. The committee will decide the issue price, rights entitlement ratio, record date, and other terms for a rights issue of fully paid-up equity shares. The total amount raised will not exceed Rs. 49,75,00,000. This follows board approval on August 14, 2026, and in-principle approval from the stock exchange. The trading window for equity shares is closed from Friday, November 13, 2026, until 48 hours after the committee meeting concludes. The managing director is Arun Kumar Jain, with DIN 00438324. The company is listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange with scrip code 543211 and symbol BONLON. It is also listed on the National Stock Exchange with symbol BONLON. The ISIN is INE0B9A01018.
